preconditions: Surfaces use one declared vertical datum and coordinate reference
Older units exist before an erosion operation

eventSemantics.Deposition: Adds younger material with non-negative thickness
eventSemantics.Erosion: Truncates pre-existing material before younger deposition
eventSemantics.Nondeposition: Represents elapsed time without requiring geometric removal
eventSemantics.Pinchout: Represents thickness converging to zero within a depositional body
eventSemantics.Onlap: A younger body terminates against an older event surface
eventSemantics.Nonpenetration: An evidence-limit state, not a geological event
eventSemantics.MissingRecord: A data-quality state, not a geological event

decisionLogic: Erosion requires positive truncation, erosional-surface, basal-lag, weathering-surface, or equivalent evidence
Conflicting erosion, pinchout, and nondeposition evidence remains unresolved
Older contacts cannot continue above a validated erosion surface
exclusions: No universal event frequency or magnitude is inferred
No region-specific erosion depth is embedded
No absent borehole interval is automatically labelled erosion
validationMethod: positive, negative, boundary, conflicting-evidence and missing-data unit tests
reopenCondition: Event schema changes or an additional globally distinct event relation is required
